Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Delivery Management.
Business:
Group AI L3
Principal Responsibilities
Change strategy and planning: Translate approved pilot scope, operating-model components and implementation milestones into integrated change and adoption plans, with clear impacts, audiences, ownership, dependencies, readiness criteria and success measures.
Impact and readiness: Assess changes to roles, accountabilities, decision rights, governance, interactions, processes, tooling and management information; identify readiness gaps and coordinate practical actions before deployment.
Stakeholder engagement and communications: Build trusted relationships across pilot Value Streams, business, technology and enabling functions; segment stakeholders, tailor messages, maintain feedback loops and secure commitment from leaders and impacted teams.
Coaching and capability: Coach leaders and teams to apply approved Value Stream roles, interaction patterns, outcome-led prioritisation and flow-based ways of working; coordinate learning, guidance and reusable adoption materials.
Pilot mobilisation, adoption and collaboration: Lead day-to-day change across assigned pilots, support implementation events and governance, and address threats from understanding, ownership, behaviour or readiness. Partner with Optimisation Design and Execution Leads and Architecture, Maturity and Tooling teams, preserving their accountabilities for design authority, implementation ownership, benefits and Value Stream outcomes.
Adoption insight and evidence: Define and track qualitative and quantitative indicators of readiness, participation, behaviour and sustained use; establish baselines where practical and provide transparent insight on progress and priority support needs.
Learning and scale-up: Capture pilot evidence, retrospectives and lessons learned; distinguish local implementation issues from design defects; translate findings into recommendations, playbooks and change requirements for subsequent waves.
Risk, control and governance: Maintain disciplined change governance and records; proactively manage resistance, dependencies, operational and people risks; escalate material issues with clear impacts, options and recommendations.
Requirements
Strong experience delivering change, readiness and adoption in complex transformation or operating-model programmes within a large, matrixed organisation.
Ability to turn approved designs and implementation plans into structured, practical adoption activity, impact assessments, stakeholder and communications plans, learning interventions and readiness actions, with clear ownership and outcomes across people, roles, governance, processes and tools.
Experience supporting pilots or phased implementations across business and technology teams, capturing evidence and adapting through test-and-learn cycles. Use feedback, readiness and adoption data and operational evidence to assess progress, target material gaps, refine interventions and inform scale-up decisions.
Good working knowledge of Value Stream Management, product and portfolio operating models, Lean and agile delivery, including outcome-led prioritisation, flow, demand and capacity management.
Strong written, verbal, presentation and influencing skills: make complex change accessible, build alignment across senior stakeholders and delivery teams, manage diverse stakeholder groups and influence without formal authority. Work collaboratively and inclusively across organisational boundaries, building trust and ownership in others.
Strong coaching and facilitation skills to help leaders and teams understand, practise and sustain new accountabilities, behaviours and ways of working; remain outcome-focused and accountable for sustained adoption and practical results.
Strong risk and control awareness and delivery discipline: manage resistance, dependencies, readiness gaps, operational and people impacts and multiple priorities through transparent governance and timely escalation. Challenge constructively and pragmatically, surface trade-offs and maintain trusted relationships.
Strong analytical judgement and problem-solving skills, making pragmatic, evidence-led decisions with limited guidance or incomplete information. Be self-directed, resilient and adaptable through ambiguity, changing pilot conditions and competing demands; build cohesive relationships across organisational and geographic boundaries and use curiosity, evidence and feedback to strengthen subsequent waves.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Main Responsibilities

Booking Control & Validation: Ensure all global market and treasury transactions are accurately booked in relevant systems in accordance with established policies and procedures, with zero exceptions or delays.
Treasury Forecasting: Contribute to accurate and timely treasury forecasts by providing reliable data and insights related to expected cash flows and exposures.
Payment Processing & SSI Management: Execute payments efficiently and accurately, and manage the creation and maintenance of Standard Settlement Instructions (SSIs) to prevent settlement failures.
Trade Confirmation Drafting & Matching: Prepare and match trade confirmations with external counterparties, ensuring all details are accurate and discrepancies are resolved promptly.
Reconciliation: Perform regular and rigorous reconciliations of trades, positions, and cash with external agents, custodians, and internal systems to identify and resolve any breaks.
Daily Task Declaration: Accurately and promptly declare all completed daily tasks in the designated operational tool, ensuring complete audit trails.· Fee Management: Accurately process and reconcile all fees associated with global market and treasury activities.
Regulatory requirements: Perform controls, submit reporting and participate to regulatory testing.
Governance, Compliance and Risk Management
Issue Identification & Escalation: Proactively identify, investigate, and escalate any operational issues, risks, or discrepancies to management as soon as detected, ensuring timely resolution.
Regulatory Reporting: Support the accurate and timely preparation and submission of daily, weekly, and monthly regulatory reports as required by local Chinese authorities.
Operational Excellence: Adhere strictly to all internal controls, policies, and procedures to achieve operational excellence, defined by zero defaults and zero delays in all assigned responsibilities. Update procedures once a year.
Qualifications and Education Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
At least 8 of relevant experience in operations specifically on global markets activities (e.g., FX, fixed income, derivatives, money markets).
Proven experience working within a treasury or financial markets operational environment.

Functional Skills
Strong understanding of global markets products and transactions.
Proficiency in trade lifecycle management.
Experience with financial reconciliation processes.
Knowledge of payment systems and processes.
Familiarity with treasury operations and cash management principles.
Transformative Skills
Automation Min
dset: Proactively identify opportunities for automation within daily processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors.
Process Optimization: A strong desire and capability to analyze existing processes, identify inefficiencies, and propose and implement improvements.
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to methodically analyze complex issues, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions.
Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to tasks, ensuring accuracy and completeness in all operational activities.
Communication Skills: Clear and concise verbal and written communication to effectively interact with diverse stakeholders.

Job Summary
Turn market insights into meaningful client conversations. In this role, you will bring the Bank’s Chief Investment Office (CIO) and House View to life for frontline teams and clients, translating economic developments and financial market trends into clear, relevant commentary.
You will develop insights for client engagement, media exposure and seminars, while helping frontline teams connect macroeconomic themes with asset allocation discussions. Working with product teams, you will also support product solutions, contribute to the Bank’s brand visibility and manage relevant projects.
Key Responsibilities
Communicate the Bank’s views on key economic drivers, emerging trends and market movements to frontline teams and clients.
Develop clear, insightful content reflecting WRB’s views and the financial markets outlook for client communications, media exposure and seminars.
Help frontline teams interpret macroeconomic developments and apply these insights to asset allocation discussions.
Enhance SCB’s brand visibility by sharing relevant market commentary through authorised communication channels.
Provide economic and market insights to support the development of product solutions.
Coordinate and deliver projects supporting market commentary, communication of the House View and related initiatives.
Ideal Candidate
A Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or CFA designation would be an advantage.
8-10 years of experience in investment strategy, equity research or portfolio management within a bank, asset manager or financial institution.
A strong understanding of global equity markets, company fundamentals, valuation methodologies, earnings trends and sector dynamics.
Solid experience in equity sector allocation, with the ability to assess economic cycles, sector valuations and earnings trends to inform sector positioning and rotation strategies.
Analytical capability assess economic developments, monetary policy and market data, translating findings into well-supported equity views and asset allocation insights.
Strong writing and presentation skills with fluent Cantonese, Mandarin and English and the ability to explain complex investment themes clearly to clients, frontline teams and other stakeholders. Experience delivering market briefings, seminars or media commentary would be an advantage.
A team player to work effectively with investment specialists, product teams and frontline colleagues, managing competing priorities and delivering timely commentary and projects.
A client-focused approach, strong attention to detail and an understanding of the regulatory and compliance standards governing investment communications.

Key Responsibilities
Are you interested in algorithmic trading? Are you an innovative thinker and enjoy building a business leading platform? We’re looking for someone like that who can:
– Help design and enhance trading algorithms and analytics for the equities business (and beyond)
– Back test trading strategies across different market regimes
– Analyze the way our clients trade to optimize their interactions with UBS
– Provide execution consultancy on client order flow, including the use of Transaction Cost Analysis
– Research market microstructure and produce analysis for clients
– Work closely with Electronic Trading, Equity front office, and IT to deliver regional and global projects

You’ll be working in the Algorithms and Analytics team in London. Our role is to provide trading algorithms and execution consultancy for electronic trading for all equities and other products. You have
– At least one relevant internship within a trading, markets, quantitative or closely related environment.
– Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.
– A proactive, self-driven approach and a strong sense of ownership.
– The ability to learn quickly, adapt to new topics and solve problems independently.
– Good organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
– Strong curiosity and interest in electronic trading, quantitative analysis and technology.

– Programme confidently in Python and/or Java and work effectively with modern IDEs and AI-assisted/agentic coding tools.

– Understand the fundamentals of machine learning and Large Language Models (LLMs), or demonstrate relevant hands-on exposure.
